title: Artifact contract and hostile fixture
objective: Freeze artifact v1 and make multiplicity, missingness, choice types, coding, and broken references executable in the local loop
live_gate: make verify-fast with the hostile fixture and literal expected rows
iteration_gate: Run the affected driver/fixture test after each issue and keep the owned warm stack for the next issue
integration_gate: Run repository driver tests and make verify-fast once at package head; run verify-full because the fixture/driver changes
performance_gate: Record cold/warm fixture load, preview, and export baselines without claiming improvements
migration_gate: Artifact v1 is new; keep the existing smoke fixture and existing receipt manifests readable
rollback: Revert P0 commits; no production data mutation is authorized
user_demo: One Patient has two Observations and the acceptance driver can assert the exact ambiguity and artifact files

title: Explicit row grain and relationship policy
objective: Show what one row means and prevent silent one-to-many collapse from being called lossless or ML-ready
unit_gate: go test ./internal/explorer/... ./internal/server; cd ui && npm test -- GuidedGraphWorkspace RouteExtensionPanel DataframeContractPanel
live_gate: Drive the two-Observation route through Builder; unsafe scalar publication is blocked or explicitly lossy
iteration_gate: Run focused Go and UI behavior tests after each contract slice; use HMR/Air for the corresponding DOM assertion
integration_gate: Run Go/UI/contract gates and make verify-fast at package head
performance_gate: Measure capability/reconcile/preview warm latency; investigate a repeated >10% regression
migration_gate: Version the row-policy/receipt contract and explain legacy implicit-FIRST drafts instead of silently changing their meaning
rollback: Revert P1 before any P2 migration; keep legacy drafts readable but not falsely safe
user_demo: Builder says one row per Patient, shows zero/one/many relationship counts, and requires an explicit safe policy

title: Repeated-value projection chooser
objective: Let a researcher intentionally choose scalar, indexed, array, distinct, or lossy-first representation and see the resulting shape
unit_gate: go test ./internal/explorer/...; cd ui && npm test -- ColumnSelector authoring
live_gate: Choose ALL INDEXED DISTINCT and FIRST in Builder and compare receipt Preview Viewer and schema
iteration_gate: Run projection-mode behavior tests after every command/compiler/UI unit; inspect literal rendered values
integration_gate: Run Go/UI/contract gates and make verify-fast at package head
performance_gate: Measure reconcile and preview latency for each mode; investigate repeated >10% regression
migration_gate: Version UPDATE_COLUMN source semantics; migrate saved drafts explicitly and retain authored intent
rollback: Revert P2 as one sequence; do not leave UI controls advertising modes the backend cannot persist
user_demo: A repeated Observation value becomes the exact representation selected by the user with a visible loss warning when applicable

title: Derived feature studio
objective: Author Observation count, filtered count, and existence through a guided frontend and prove value parity end to end
unit_gate: go test ./internal/explorer/... ./internal/dataframe/recipe/... ./internal/dataframe/semantic/... ./internal/dataframe/compiler/lower/...; cd ui && npm test -- DerivedFeature
live_gate: Author total and final-only Observation counts; assert exact Preview published Viewer and export values
iteration_gate: Run one literal feature-value behavior test after each domain/compiler/UI slice; use the warm API for receipt parity
integration_gate: Run backend/compiler/UI/contract gates and make verify-fast at the accepted branch head
performance_gate: Measure authoring/reconcile/preview latency for the hostile fixture; investigate repeated >10% regression
migration_gate: Add a versioned source union and migrate all authoring callers in the same wave; no compatibility wrapper chain
rollback: Revert the P3 branch before integration; published feature receipts require forward migration after release
user_demo: A researcher adds count and final-only count without recipes or AQL and sees the exact expected values everywhere

title: FHIR explanation and semantic presentation
objective: Use one semantic column descriptor and one null/array policy across Builder Preview Viewer and artifacts
unit_gate: go test ./internal/fhir/schema/...; cd ui && npm test -- ExplorerViewer semantic PreviewTable DataframeContractPanel
live_gate: Expand repeated choice and coding columns in Builder and Viewer; plain-language and exact FHIR details agree
iteration_gate: Run formatter/descriptor behavior tests after each semantic case and a targeted Viewer DOM assertion
integration_gate: Run FHIR/UI gates and make verify-fast after integration with P3 shared contracts
performance_gate: Measure warm table/filter interaction and bundle size; investigate repeated >10% regressions and report chunks
migration_gate: Version the column descriptor; map legacy runtime payloads once at the API boundary then delete the old internal shape
rollback: Revert the P5 branch before integration; keep stable physical keys and authored labels unchanged
user_demo: The same feature has the same label path shape null meaning code system and value rendering in every surface

title: Coverage and ML-readiness evidence
objective: Turn Preview into a decision surface with measured quality, row-key integrity, cardinality, and actionable readiness reasons
unit_gate: go test ./internal/explorer/... ./internal/dataframe/published/... ./internal/api/graphql/graph/dataframe/...; cd ui && npm test -- PreviewTable DataframeContractPanel
live_gate: Preview the hostile fixture and assert coverage missingness duplicate key relationship cardinality and readiness reason text
iteration_gate: Run one metric/reason behavior test per issue and use the warm API/DOM for visible remediation
integration_gate: Run backend/GraphQL/UI/contract gates and make verify-fast at package head
performance_gate: Measure profile query latency and peak retained rows/bytes at small and multi-page fixtures; enforce explicit limits
migration_gate: Add versioned quality/readiness reason codes; old clients may ignore new fields but must not infer a false ready state
rollback: Revert P4 code and schema together; quality sidecars are additive until artifact v1 is published
user_demo: An all-null feature is visibly blocked or warned with counts and remediation instead of merely displaying dashes

title: Pinned portable dataset artifact
objective: Stream one immutable data snapshot with schema provenance quality and human documentation in a checksummed archive
unit_gate: go test ./internal/api/graphql/graph/dataframe/... ./internal/dataframe/published/... ./internal/dataset/...; cd ui && npm test -- Viewer ExplorerViewer
live_gate: Begin export on revision A publish revision B and prove every artifact file remains pinned to A; simulate stream failure
iteration_gate: Run export format/manifest behavior tests per issue and targeted download DOM/API checks on the warm stack
integration_gate: Run full Go/dataframe/OpenAPI/GraphQL/UI gates and make verify-fast; run the complete product browser scenario once
performance_gate: Measure export throughput peak memory archive size and browser heap avoidance; explicit limit failures are not regressions
migration_gate: Artifact format is independently versioned; keep CSV/JSONL compatibility and make Parquet availability explicit
rollback: Revert P6 before external artifact consumption; after release use a new artifact version rather than mutating v1
user_demo: Download an archive whose data schema quality provenance README and checksums all name one immutable materialization
